answer: Anyone running 126 aliases thus needs 36 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are logged in wharf, expire in river, and glacier lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3855 identities would post 1149 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
